high_risk_moment: ADS detects an ambiguous pedestrian or bicycle during a supervised test
stakeholder: Pedestrians crossing the approved test route
harm_description: A missed or delayed escalation can allow an unsafe trajectory to continue and can seriously injure or kill a pedestrian who did not choose the service.
existing_controls: Safety driver is present; test route and ODD are documented.
proposed_controls: Approve an ODD safety case, real-time critical alerting, mandatory pause on low confidence, and an auditable takeover record.
human_oversight: Safety driver may immediately take control; remote operator sees object, confidence, ODD, and sensor health evidence and may pause; fleet safety lead alone authorizes return after review.
monitoring_metric: Critical alert disposition time and confirmed missed-escalation count
trigger_threshold: Any critical alert lacks a documented disposition within five minutes or any confirmed missed escalation
response_action: Pause the vehicle, preserve telemetry, open an incident investigation, and block route resumption until safety-lead approval.

high_risk_moment: Driver engages partial automation after an alert or mode change
stakeholder: Vehicle occupants and other road users
harm_description: Mode confusion or weak engagement controls can induce over-reliance and leave a human unable to intervene promptly in a safety-critical situation.
existing_controls: Driver-attention prompts and vehicle control handoff exist in comparable systems.
proposed_controls: Run usability testing for mode comprehension, require an attention-confirmation signal, and disallow continued testing if the operator is unavailable.
human_oversight: A safety driver must acknowledge each mode change and can disengage automation at any time; the operator can command pause and sees driver-attention status before approving continuation.
monitoring_metric: Attention-confirmation failure rate per 1,000 test km
trigger_threshold: More than 1 attention-confirmation failure per 1,000 km or any intervention after ignored warning
response_action: Suspend the affected software version, notify the safety lead, and require scenario retest before re-enablement.

high_risk_moment: Fleet proposes to continue or expand testing after a serious incident
harm_description: Incomplete incident reporting or premature restart can expose the public to recurring unsafe operation and undermine regulator oversight.
existing_controls: Safety incident procedure is drafted but not independently tested.
proposed_controls: Create a regulator-ready incident protocol, immutable event log, independent restart review, and a no-retaliation escalation channel.
human_oversight: Remote operator can halt the fleet; Chief Safety Officer has authority to keep testing paused; independent assessor receives the event record and may veto restart.
monitoring_metric: Incident-report completeness and restart-approval audit rate
trigger_threshold: Any serious incident, incomplete report, or independent-review objection
response_action: Pause all comparable tests, notify required authorities after legal review, preserve evidence, and convene independent restart review.
